PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.SEC1_TEXT: Protecting your personal data is very important to me. This privacy policy informs you about the type, scope, and purpose of the processing of personal data (hereinafter referred to as "data") within my portfolio website.
PRIVACY.SEC2_TEXT: For the data processing on this website, the person named in the Imprint of this portfolio is responsible.
PRIVACY.SEC3_TEXT: When you visit my website, your browser automatically transmits data to the server hosting this portfolio. This data is collected for technical reasons to ensure a smooth connection setup and system security of the website. It is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis for this processing is our legitimate interest in the secure and error-free operation of the website.
PRIVACY.SEC4_TEXT: If you contact me via email or a contact form provided on this portfolio, the details you provide (such as your name and email address) will be stored for the purpose of processing your request and in case of follow-up questions. I will not share this data without your consent.
PRIVACY.SEC5_TEXT: This portfolio website does not use tracking cookies, analytics tools (like Google Analytics), or third-party marketing trackers.
PRIVACY.SEC6_TEXT: You have the right to request information about your stored personal data, its origin, recipients, and the purpose of data processing at any time free of charge. You also have the right to request the correction or deletion of your data. If you have questions regarding this, you can contact me using the contact details provided in the Imprint.
